sloka: सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः सर्व काल मनोहरैः ।तत्र भुक्त्वा वर अर्हाणि मूलानि च फलानि च ॥४-४१-३३॥
transliteration: sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ sarva kāla manoharaiḥ ।tatra bhuktvā vara arhāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca ॥4-41-33॥

translations.english: 'Beyond that mountain lies Vaidyuta, a hill with trees yielding lovely fruits in all seasons which can satisfy all desires.
